newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 1997 aluminium exports seen flat on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Russian 1997 aluminium exports seen flat on 1996.

text.p: Russian primary aluminium exports in 1996 were 2.44 million tonnes, according to the Kontsern Alyuminiy producers' group, which had earlier put exports at 2.37 million tonnes.

The group told a news conference that 1997 exports would be about the same as 1996's level. It said it saw 1997 primary aluminium output rising two to three percent on 1996, revising its earlier forecast that output would grow 1.5-2.0 percent.
The data was provided by the group's general director, Igor Prokopov, who was speaking on the results of the group's recent board meeting.
Kontsern Alyuminy is a joint-stock company whose members are Russia's aluminium industry enterprises.
